sloka: प्रभग्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः ।गदा पाणिः अवप्लुत्य तस्थौ भूमौ खरः तदा ॥३-२८-३२॥
transliteration: prabhagna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ ।gadā pāṇiḥ avaplutya tasthau bhūmau kharaḥ tadā ॥3-28-32॥

translations.english: Then, with bow broken, chariot destroyed, horses and charioteer dead, Khara jumped down the chariot and stood on the ground holding a mace.
